card.name: Units of measure after a number
card.fires_on: The unit word right after a number ending in zero, such as kilometres, -minute, bpm, msec, hours, /mm, yrs or words. It is strongest when the number is round and the unit is a measure.

modes.label: Time and rate units
modes.description: A time or rate unit follows a round number, as in dosing or monitoring text.

modes.label: Distance, count and other units
modes.description: A distance, temperature, cell-count or length unit follows a number ending in zero.

card.writes: It seems to push toward unit or number continuations and away from unrelated English words like better or stroke.
card.plain: It fires on the unit word, like hours or bpm, that comes right after a round number.
